scope: Existing WebUSB waiting/partial-RX/response/sending/Hold/PIN/FIDO-source states across two global lifecycle transitions, with deferred status and refused requests, serialized cleanup, old-source rejection, PIN revocation and recovery. Event-level EP0 completions; no arbitrary executing IRQ or physical USB/CIU acceptance.

cases.preconditions: Configured product with the named existing WebUSB transaction. Main-loop cleanup withheld during reset/reconfiguration and status/refused request observations; all EP0 IN completions explicit. No OUT follows rejected SETUP. After cleanup old response and PIN are revoked.
